scope: Policy, deterministic frame-timing fixtures and actual game handlers with renderer/storage doubles. Timing fixtures are not phone performance measurements.
checks: 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 steps; no full-DPR jump; two-million-pixel mobile cap
15-second frame interval summaries, warm-up exclusion, p95 and slow-frame counts
Sampling cancels on pause, viewport/profile change, menu or location change
Both resolution controls save immediately and survive reload; graphics preference/shadows and ownership/layout/money/daily state preserved
Older saves migrate safely; invalid resolution import rejected
